name: Applied Digital

logo.source: applieddigital.com site header logo (APLD - Logo.svg, dark version used on the light header)

description: Applied Digital builds and runs very large data-center campuses, mostly in North Dakota, and rents the powered space to AI and cloud tenants under 15-year take-or-pay leases. The tenants are CoreWeave and investment-grade hyperscalers whose names the filings do not give; they pay a base rent per megawatt of critical IT load plus recoveries of power and other costs. As of 2026-05-31 it had signed leases for about 1,410 MW across five campuses worth about $36.2 billion over the base terms, but only about 100 MW was live then (250 MW by 2026-10-01). It began as a bitcoin-mining host, and that legacy business (one miner renting 286 MW in North Dakota, contract about one and a half years left) still earned more segment profit than the AI business in FY2026. It also controls about 96% of ChronoScale (CHRN), the former GPU-cloud unit, which is consolidated in the numbers. A large part of AI-segment revenue is pass-through construction (tenant fit-out) billed at almost no margin, so reported revenue overstates the rent stream.

hq.note: 3811 Turtle Creek Boulevard, Suite 2100, Dallas, TX 75219; incorporated in Nevada (FY2026 10-K cover)

businessLines.name: HPC Hosting Business
businessLines.how: Tenants pay a long-term base rent per megawatt of critical IT load under non-cancellable, take-or-pay 15-year leases (three five-year renewal options), plus recoveries of power and operating costs. A second revenue stream is tenant fit-out services, which APLD builds and bills at roughly cost (FY2026: $270.6M of revenue against $258.1M of cost), so it inflates revenue but earns little.
businessLines.description: Purpose-built AI data-center campuses leased to CoreWeave and investment-grade hyperscalers: Polaris Forge 1, 2 and 3 (North Dakota), Delta Forge 1 and 2 (southern US).
businessLines.revenueNote: Services revenue $270,602K (tenant fit-out) plus data center rental and other $114,702K (about $99.8M base rent and $14.9M tenant recoveries). Latest quarter Q1 FY2027 (ended 2026-08-31): $262,638K, of which $65.8M base rent, $183.5M fit-out and $13.3M recoveries.

businessLines.name: Data Center Hosting Business
businessLines.how: A bitcoin miner rents energized space and power at APLD's sites under a five-year contract with about one and a half years left (per FY2026 10-K), paying for the power it uses plus a hosting margin. The customer may reduce or end the contract with notice, and the company expects this line to shrink in relative terms.
businessLines.description: Legacy hosting of bitcoin-mining machines at Jamestown, ND (106 MW) and Ellendale, ND (180 MW), 286 MW in total, both at full capacity as of 2026-08-31.
businessLines.revenueNote: Q1 FY2027: $37,755K. One crypto-mining customer was 25% of FY2026 continuing-operations revenue (customer not named in the sections read).

businessLines.name: ChronoScale (former Cloud Services, reported inside Other)
businessLines.how: Rents access to GPU compute equipment (monthly, by capacity) to AI developers, and since Q1 FY2027 also resells AI infrastructure hardware with support services. A two-year Microsoft partnership (extended to three years) covers about 50 MW of planned AI compute.
businessLines.description: GPU cloud for AI and machine-learning developers, rented from third-party colocation sites in Colorado, Minnesota and Utah, plus GPU hardware resale since Q1 FY2027. Separated on 2026-05-05; APLD owned about 96% on 2026-08-31 and consolidates it. Legacy Ekso Bionics business sold 2026-09-30 and shown as discontinued.
businessLines.revenueNote: Derived as company-reported ChronoScale revenue excluded from adjusted revenue. Q1 FY2027: $41,482K, including about $23.0M of GPU hardware sales.

brands.name: ChronoScale Holdings (Nasdaq: CHRN)
brands.share: About 96% owned by APLD on 2026-08-31 (Q1 FY2027 10-Q); 11.7% of FY2026 revenue and 12.1% of Q1 FY2027 revenue (computed)

brands.name: Polaris Forge 1
brands.share: 400 MW leased to CoreWeave; 250 MW live on 2026-10-01

brands.name: Polaris Forge 2, Polaris Forge 3, Delta Forge 1, Delta Forge 2
brands.share: 1,010 MW leased and under construction (200 + 300 + 300 + 210), none billing as of 2026-08-31 except as the filings state for PF1

brands.name: Base Electron Corp. (about 10% equity stake)
brands.share: Independent power producer developing about 1,200 MW of gas-fired generation in North Dakota; APLD signed a power purchase agreement on 2026-10-04 (10-Q; release 2026-10-07)

Polaris Forge 1 third building (150 MW) ready for service in calendar 2027, funded by the $1.59B 7.000% notes due 2031 closed 2026-06-16
Delta Forge 1 initial ready-for-service 1H CY2027 (full early 2028); Polaris Forge 3 initial 2H CY2027 (full 2H 2028); Delta Forge 2 210 MW in 1H CY2028

Base Electron power purchase agreement signed 2026-10-04 for capacity and energy from an about 1,200 MW gas-fired plant still to be developed in North Dakota, intended for the Polaris Forge 3 expansion
Existing hosting contract with the one crypto-mining customer has about one and a half years left (as of the FY2026 10-K filed 2026-07-29)
